clips.title: The story
paras: At Eastvale, Marshal Haggard keeps the arms he gathered over a lifetime of service. Harry Burlguard sends novice warriors from Stormwind City to meet the retired marshal and seek better weapons.

Stormwind's novice warriors need more than skill to face danger beyond the city. Harry Burlguard sends promising fighters east through Elwynn Forest to find Marshal Haggard, a retired officer who served the realm for years. Haggard gathered a personal armory over a lifetime in the field, and his home near the Eastvale Logging Camp holds weapons for young warriors seeking better arms.

Marshal Haggard lives in a secluded manor near the Eastvale Logging Camp. Years of service have weakened his failing sight, and he sometimes mistakes approaching travelers for prowling riverpaw gnolls. Though age keeps him in this quiet corner of eastern Elwynn, Stormwind's guards and trainers still respect the old marshal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've learned a few moves, but you could still use a decent weapon. I bet if you spoke with Marshal Haggard he could help you.
Marshal Haggard lives in a manor in Elwynn Forest, at the Eastvale Lumber Camp. He's retired now but he collected a lot of gear during his career.
Let him know I sent you, and with luck he'll have a spare weapon to offer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Who's that? Burlguard, is that you? You'll have to step a little closer. My eyes aren't what they used to be. Walking up like that, I thought you were a gnoll!
